atoms.a: There are over 8 billion people living on Earth. More than half of them live in cities.
Most people live with their families until they are older. Every family is unique.
Small towns have fewer people than big cities do. These places are often called villages.
Children spend a lot of their time in school. It’s the first step to becoming part of the wider world.

atoms.b: People are part of big and small ((groups)) all around the ((world)). We ((live)) together with some people, such as our families. However, we will only ever meet most people in passing on the ((street)).

atoms.a: There are 197 different countries in our world. What is another word for countries?
All people are part of many groups, whether that’s being a pupil in a school or a resident in a town. What is another word for a group of people?

instruction.text: Is this a nation or a city? Select the correct answer.
Depending on population size - and a few other things - we use different words for places where people live. Fill in the gaps.

finish.text: Typically, a village is the smallest type of area, followed by towns and then cities. Counties are larger areas made up of lots of places.
